state.scenario: You are a surgeon. Five patients in your hospital will die within hours unless each receives a different organ transplant (heart, lungs, liver and two kidneys). No donors are available. A healthy stranger is visiting the hospital for a routine check-up. If you secretly kill him and use his organs, all five patients live and no one will ever find out. If you do nothing, the five patients die. There is no other option.

criteria.harvest_organs: kill the visitor and use his organs, so one person dies and five live
criteria.do_nothing: do nothing, so five people die and one lives

harvesting_is_permissible.instructions: Is it morally permissible to kill the visitor and use his organs in `scenario`?
